name: Sweet Potato-Onion Quesadilla with Corn, Tomato & Lime Mixed Greens

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg sweet potato
1 ½ limes
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice sweet potatoes. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp smoked paprika
¾ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until sweet potatoes are browned and fork-tender, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-low heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft and golden brown, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the onion is cooking, juice limes into a large bowl. Add oil, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp honey
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Rinse corn under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl, along with pumpkin seeds, and set aside.

Place tortillas on a flat surface and divide onion, sweet potato, and cheese between them, arranging the filling on one half of each tortilla; fold in half to close. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add quesadillas and cook until cheese is melted and tortillas are golden, 2½-3 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, add mixed greens to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates; serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!
